title: Ram Charan reaches Coimbatore hospital with Chiranjeevi and Upasana for wrist surgery after 'Peddi' shoot injury - Reports
summary: Actor Ram Charan reportedly reached a Coimbatore hospital accompanied by Chiranjeevi and Upasana for wrist surgery following an injury sustained during the shoot of 'Peddi'. No official statement has been released by the actor's team or the hospital; fans and colleagues are awaiting updates on his condition.

According to multiple reports, actor Ram Charan reached a hospital in Coimbatore for wrist surgery after suffering an injury during the shoot of the film 'Peddi'. The actor was reportedly accompanied to the medical facility by his father, veteran actor Chiranjeevi, and his wife Upasana. Details surrounding the incident and the exact timing of the injury remain limited in public reports.

Sources cited in entertainment coverage indicate that the surgery is related to a wrist injury sustained on set while filming 'Peddi'. Media accounts emphasize that the information comes from preliminary reports and that official confirmation from Ram Charan's representatives or the hospital has not yet been issued.

Fans and colleagues in the film industry have been offering messages of support on social media platforms as they await further updates on the actor's condition and recovery timeline. The situation has prompted expressions of concern from followers and contemporaries across Tollywood and beyond.

The Times of India will continue to monitor developments and will publish official statements or medical updates as they become available. Until then, reports advise caution in treating early accounts as final, and recommend relying on confirmed communications from Ram Charan's team or the treating medical facility for accurate information.
